name: Temporary WP-MVP-0004 final EOSR

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosr/review-wp-mvp-0004-final
    paths:
      - .eos/wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact review branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Conduct independent WP-MVP-0004 review
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD: 385fd7bb8631e25d4c2cdae0c2a81f8406ba734b
        run: |
          set -Eeuo pipefail
          git fetch origin main
          test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" HEAD

          cp .eos/wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr-review.py /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr-review.py
          rm .github/workflows/temporary-wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr.yml
          rm .eos/wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr-review.py
          rm .eos/wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr-trigger
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          test -z "$(git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD" -- crates engineering .eos machine | grep -v '^$')"

          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features
          cargo test -p monad-core review_front_matter_prevents_false_duplicate_governed_identifier
          cargo test -p monad-core canonical_front_matter_controls_identity_status_and_h1_fallback
          cargo test -p monad-core malformed_duplicate_or_conflicting_explicit_identity_suppresses_h1_fallback
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          ./scripts/eos state status
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

          EOS_ACTOR="ChatGPT EOSR Reviewer" ./scripts/eos review WP-MVP-0004
          python3 /tmp/wp-mvp-0004-final-eosr-review.py

          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          ./scripts/eos state status
          ./scripts/eos verify --strict
          python3 tools/eos/trace_integrity.py
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
          cargo fmt --all -- --check
          cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          cargo test --workspace --all-targets --all-features

          grep -q '^\*\*Decision:\*\* ACCEPTED$' engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0004-REVIEW.md
          grep -q '^WP-MVP-0004.*IN_REVIEW' .eos/work-packets.tsv

          mapfile -t changed < <({ git diff --name-only "$EXPECTED_MAIN_HEAD"; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; } | sort -u)
          test "${#changed[@]}" -gt 0
          for f in "${changed[@]}"; do
            case "$f" in
              .eos/*|engineering/reviews/WP-MVP-0004-REVIEW.md|engineering/evidence/*|engineering/work-packets/WP-MVP-0004.md|machine/*) ;;
              *) echo "Out-of-scope EOSR path: $f" >&2; exit 1 ;;
            esac
          done

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -A
          git diff --cached --check
          git commit -m "docs(eosr): accept WP-MVP-0004 after F001 correction"
          git push origin "HEAD:${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
